american_english: In instrumental music, tabla playing has remained an integral part of the musical field. Without rhythm, other areas of music such as singing, melody playing, and dance are considered incomplete. In the sphere of Eastern music, tabla playing has been given foremost priority as the primary medium for rhythmic musical presentation. In bringing the playing styles of various gharanas on the tabla from traditional forms to today's state, female tabla players, just like male tabla players, have also played a role. Those direct and indirect roles have brought realistic conditions to light and brought things to today's situation. As an integral part of this creation covering half the sky and bearing an indispensable and essential role in creation and creativity, the power of women demonstrates an equally potent role in the realm of tabla playing in the music world; bringing to light facts found everywhere in reality, along with plentiful examples of women who have sacrificed body, mind, and wealth, is the main goal here.
